sources.label: Official Berghaus Women's Size Guide for Jackets, Fleeces, Base Layers, Shirts & Tees (Alpha Sizes, CM)

audit: Old /en-gb/customer-service/size-guide 404s; guide is /pages/size-guide-womens-apparel. Alpha chart: S UK 10 88/70/93 -> UK 8-10 81-86/89-94 (no waist); L UK 14 99/81/104 -> UK 12-14 91-96/99-104; XL UK 16 105/87/110 -> UK 14-16 96-101/104-109. Old rows paired each letter with one UK size; Berghaus prints two per letter. Waist removed: Berghaus prints no waist for this chart. US/EU removed. 2XL, 3XL added. Separate UK Sizes (8-20) chart on the page gives single values per UK size.
